en_title: Bit Reactor CEO Welcomes Return of Some Furloughed Staff for 'Continued Support' of Star Wars Zero Company
cn_title: 《星球大战 零号连队》Bit Reactor召回部分休假员工
subtitle: 继续支持《星球大战 零号连队》
opus_summary: 《星球大战 零号连队》开发商Bit Reactor在游戏发售前安排约八成员工无薪休假，如今已有部分员工返岗。CEO Greg Foertsch称，此举是继续支持游戏的重要一步。

paragraphs.en: Bit Reactor, the developer of Star Wars Zero Company, has begun returning some of its staff to the team after furloughing an estimated 80% of employees just before the game’s launch.
paragraphs.cn: 《星球大战 零号连队》开发商Bit Reactor已开始让部分员工重返团队。就在游戏发售前，该工作室曾安排约80%的员工无薪休假。

paragraphs.en: Bit Reactor’s CEO Greg Foertsch revealed the news in a public post on October 7, where he explained that the furloughs were necessary to “help us eventually bring as many people back as possible.”
paragraphs.cn: Bit Reactor首席执行官Greg Foertsch于10月7日公开发文披露了这一消息。他解释说，安排员工无薪休假是必要之举，目的是「帮助我们最终让尽可能多的人回来」。

paragraphs.en: Foertsh said that bringing these staff members back to Bit Reactor was an “important step forward” in the studio’s “continued support for Zero Company,” and that the team looks forward to sharing more updates about the game “soon.”
paragraphs.cn: Greg Foertsch表示，让这些员工回到Bit Reactor，是工作室「继续支持《星球大战 零号连队》」的「重要一步」。团队期待「很快」分享更多游戏消息。

paragraphs.en: “Having to ask team members to step away after we navigated unexpected business developments outside of our control and so close to launch was an incredibly difficult decision,” Foertsh wrote. “...This team means a tremendous amount to me, and I am incredibly proud of what we have accomplished together. Thank you to our fans for the incredible response to the game and for supporting us along this journey.”
paragraphs.cn: Greg Foertsch写道：「在应对了我们无法控制、出乎意料的业务变动之后，又不得不在临近发售时请团队成员暂时离开，这是一个极其艰难的决定。……这支团队对我意义重大，我为我们共同取得的成果感到无比自豪。感谢粉丝对游戏的热烈反响，也感谢大家一路以来的支持。」

paragraphs.en: Sources with information about the situation told GameFile that the number of Bit Reactor’s payrolled staff now account for “more than half of what it had been ahead of the furloughs,” meaning that there is still a sizeable chunk of furloughed staff who aren’t getting paid.
paragraphs.cn: 知情人士告诉GameFile，目前Bit Reactor领取薪酬的员工人数已达到无薪休假前的「一半以上」。这意味着仍有相当一部分休假员工没有领到薪酬。

paragraphs.en: Star Wars Zero Company launched in August 2026 to rave reviews, getting a sparkling nine out of 10 from our reviewers here at IGN who praised it for being an “excellent tactical game that does a fantastic job of slathering on the same cinematic look and feel we saw in Respawn's Star Wars Jedi games, incorporating strong characters and a storyline that's refreshingly centered on non-Force users and a non-traditional villain.”
paragraphs.cn: 《星球大战 零号连队》于2026年8月发售，收获广泛好评。IGN评测给出了9分（满分10分），称赞它是「一款出色的战术游戏，成功营造出与Respawn的《星球大战绝地》系列相同的电影质感，同时塑造了鲜明的角色。其故事以非原力使用者和一位非传统反派为核心，令人耳目一新」。

paragraphs.en: Despite its success, much of Bit Reactor’s staff were placed on leave without pay just before Zero Company launched, with reports indicating around 80% of employees were affected. This has become a recurring trend within the game development industry, to the point where Gears of War: E-Day developers were overcome with worry that they would get laid off after “crunching hard” to get the game out on time.
paragraphs.cn: 尽管游戏取得了成功，Bit Reactor仍在《星球大战 零号连队》发售前安排大批员工无薪休假。据报道，约80%的员工受到影响。类似情况在游戏开发行业屡次出现，甚至让《战争机器：事变日》的开发者担心，自己在为确保游戏按时推出而「拼命赶工」后，会遭到裁员。

paragraphs.en: This is the latest news to get revealed about Zero Company after GameFile uncovered legal documents revealing that the game was initially pitched as a title within the Titanfall universe , with specific connections to Apex Legends . While this pitch ultimately didn’t go through, it’s certainly intriguing enough to make us wonder what such a game would have looked like, had it actually been made.
paragraphs.cn: 这是继GameFile发现一批法律文件后，关于《星球大战 零号连队》的最新消息。文件显示，这款游戏最初的提案将其设定在《泰坦陨落》宇宙中，并与《Apex英雄》有具体联系。虽然这一提案最终未获采纳，但它仍足以让人好奇：如果游戏真的按此开发，最终会是什么模样？
